title: One-click quote-to-invoice
rationale: Most-watched roadmap item; removes re-entry for every accepted quote. Data already exists on the quote.

title: Automated invoice reminders
rationale: Half of active accounts send invoices that go overdue; directly supports 'get paid faster'. Low effort using existing email/SMS sending.

title: "On my way" SMS notifications
rationale: Reduces no-access visits and admin calls; simple one-tap flow.

title: Automated review requests
rationale: Supports customer acquisition via reviews; reuses SMS sending from F-10.

title: Card-on-file payments
rationale: Directly grows payment volume; payment provider already supports stored cards.

title: QuickBooks Online sync
rationale: Large ticket volume about double entry; two-way sync and edge cases make it costly.

title: Online booking page
rationale: Cited in churn exit surveys, so it supports retention; needs calendar availability logic.

title: AI quote drafting
rationale: Could cut quoting time sharply, but testers raised accuracy concerns; needs a review step before sending.

title: Dark mode
rationale: Broadly requested but cosmetic; no link to this year's strategy.

title: AI job-notes summary
rationale: Interview interest is real but untested; value depends on summary accuracy for trade jargon.

title: Offline mode for mobile app
rationale: Painful for rural users but a major architectural change to the mobile app.

title: Drag-and-drop team scheduling
rationale: High value for multi-crew accounts, but they are only about 10% of the base.

title: Customer self-service portal
rationale: Mixed interview feedback; depends on card-on-file payments.

title: Multi-currency invoicing
rationale: Clear need for a small segment; tax and rounding rules add effort.

title: Custom reporting dashboard
rationale: Requested by larger accounts, but which reports matter is unclear; needs discovery.
